# X360 Manager v1.6.8

## Fixes

- **Xenia Canary download** — GitHub renamed the Windows build (`xenia_canary_windows.zip` → `xenia_canary_windows_.zip` / `.7z`). The app now finds the real asset and extracts zip or 7z.
- **FPS overlay** — clearer note that the counter is capture-based (often ~30) and many Xbox 360 games are native 30 FPS. Use Xenia’s F3 profiler for the true render rate.

## Download

Install **X360-Manager-Setup-1.6.8.exe** (Windows 10/11, 64-bit).
